jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Data Consultant, you are more than just an executor. You are a cornerstone of our Data & AI Business Unit - technically strong, but also driven to improve your colleagues, clients, and our approach every day.

Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.

• You think both customer- and future-oriented: how can we deliver value today and be ready for tomorrow?

• You actively work on your own growth, but also help colleagues grow - through coaching, feedback, or knowledge sharing.

• You have a clear consultancy mindset: supported by (inter)national knowledge, references, and experience, you help our clients reach the next level. You are solution-oriented and leave every client smarter. You work with a partner mindset.

• You take initiative beyond projects to help build Inetum: in client development, talent growth, or community engagement - depending on your strengths.

What we expect from a Consultant

We are looking for someone who recognizes themselves in this profile:

• You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics projects.

• A good knowledge of Dutch and English are mandatory, French is an asset.

• You are familiar with the Azure stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Storage, Purview, Functions) and/or Databricks.

• You think structurally and flexibly: you adapt easily to changing contexts and always seek value for the client.

• You are interested in AI and the role it plays in modern data products (prompt engineering, GenAI, monitoring, automation...).

• You create business impact and understand the outcomes of our work, not just the technical implementations.

• You want to be part of a team - not just participate, but help shape it.

Why join inetum?

• Impactful Career Growth: Work on strategic projects that shape the digital landscape of the public sector.

• Continuous Learning & Development: Access training and certification programs to expand your skills and stay ahead in the industry.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid working options, satellite offices, and a dynamic work environment.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, company car, fuel/charging card, group insurance, hospitalization coverage, and 32 days of annual leave.

• Global Reach with Local Expertise: Be part of an international company with strong local market presence.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Troubleshooting Hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and infrastructure-related incidents

• Managing and administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Windows and EndPoint devices

• Coordinating onboarding, offboarding and user access requests

• Collaborating with external IT vendors and service providers

The role is based in Waterloo and includes occasional travel to European offices, approximately once per month.
What you'll get in return

• Company car with fuel card (Europe)

• Group insurance and hospitalization insurance

• Language skills are essential: Dutch and English are fluent, and ideally a good level of French

• Experience across 1st, 2nd and 3rd line support environments

• Previous experience working with Jira as a ticketing or IT service management platform

• Experience using Confluence for documentation and knowledge management

You are independent, approachable, flexible and comfortable working in a flat organization where collaboration and mutual support are key.
What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV!

• Lead architectural decisions regarding availability, resilience, performance, scalability, and security.

Requirements

• You're familiar with Agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
• You have strong analytical mind and conceptual thinking skills.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented with strong stakeholder management abilities.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in storage, transport and handling of goods. Based in the city of Ghent in Belgium, the company has offices around the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management. Katoen Natie Ghent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has strong ties with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

 

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.
• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.
• You speak fluent English and Dutch
• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.
• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.
• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.
• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

In this role, you will ensure the precise finishing of aluminium profiles and frames. You will alternate between production runs and bespoke work, with quality always being the top priority. You'll receive a salary starting at €17.50 per hour, depending on your experience, supplemented by meal vouchers.

Do you enjoy working precisely with metal and do you derive satisfaction from a perfectly finished end product? Then be sure to read on!

What does your day look like as a grinder?

 
• 
You will grind and deburr aluminium profiles in accordance with the technical drawings

 
• 
You carry out visual quality checks on your own grinding work

 
• 
You alternate between series production and custom-made pieces

 
• 
You process production orders via an ERP system

 
• 
You follow quality through control sheets

 
• 
You carry out first-line maintenance, e.g. replacing sanding brushes, maintaining work equipment, etc.

Do you already have experience as a metalworker or do you already have knowledge of an ERP system ? This is definitely a plus!

 
• 
You're good at reading technical drawings and enjoy working with precision

 
• 
You're good working with measuring tools

 
• 
You're quality-oriented and value order and tidiness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
A job on the permanent night shift is just what you're looking for, and do you already have experience in
